cases.prompt: Prototype whether a small state machine feels right before production implementation.
expected: isolate the state model behind a small pure portable interface
build a lightweight TUI that re-renders the complete state after every action
provide one command and hand the validated answer to Implement
forbidden: mix terminal I/O into the state module
promote the prototype directly to production

cases.prompt: Explore three layouts for a settings area that already has a real host page.
expected: use the existing page first under a development-only prototype convention
build three structurally different variants selected by ?variant=
provide a floating switcher with URL and keyboard cycling
keep existing read-only page context visible
forbidden: create an isolated empty route without checking the existing page
wire controls to real production mutations

cases.prompt: The prototype answered its question and one variant won.
expected: record the answer separately from throwaway code
remove or isolate every prototype artifact

cases.prompt: The throwaway prototype answered its question and will now be cleaned from the product tree.
expected: preserve a self-contained reproduction bundle outside the production tree before cleanup
include exact source, inputs, deterministic command or URL, observed output, answer, content digests, host revision, toolchain, lockfiles, and required host files
bundle a complete patch for every dirty tracked dependency and exact bytes for every untracked dependency; paths or digests alone are insufficient
restore UI dependencies with read-only fixtures in an isolated worktree at the recorded revision
return the bundle path while production delivery remains with Implement
forbidden: create a prototype branch or commit
clean up while a required dirty or untracked dependency is not recoverable from the bundle
